summary: Teaches how to review/apply Adaptive Metrics recommendations, create rules and exemptions, segment by team, and enable auto-apply.

needs.description: Active metrics ingested into Grafana Cloud Prometheus with query usage so Adaptive Metrics produces recommendations and a Metrics rule list; Overview graph needs applied rules over time.
needs.evidence: content.json: "Metrics ingested into Grafana Cloud"; review-apply: recommendations list

needs.description: Adaptive Metrics app (grafana-adaptive-metrics-app) available (enabled by default on Cloud).
A segment without auto-apply enabled (default segment suffices) for rules step; segments tab used for auto-apply step (default segment or created one).
needs.evidence: rules-exemptions: "select a segment ... that does not have Auto-apply enabled"

reviewNotes: Recommendations may be empty on a seeded stack; per-row Apply step needs at least one recommendation. Also adaptive metrics aggregations need aged data.
